contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the house of Valentinian (364-378), Victory left, reddish flan, Reece period 19, Arles mint. Obverse description: Bust diademed right. Reverse description: Victory advancing left; OF in left field. Reverse inscription: SECVRIT[AS REI PVBLICAE]. In exergue: CON. Diameter: 17.1mm, Weight: 1.52gms, die axis: 6
